interactions.note: The epitope of UIC2 Fab on the multidrug transporter ABCB1 (P-glycoprotein) bound to taxol was determined from cryo-electron microscopy 3D single particle reconstruction of the complex at 3.6 Å resolution. The antigen is a hybrid construct of human and mouse ABCB1 (ABCB1HM) that contains the extracellular region of the human protein, including the recognition epitope of UIC2, on a background of mouse ABCB1 and was reconstituted into nanodiscs.

The epitope of UIC2 Fab on the multidrug transporter ABCB1 (P-glycoprotein) bound to zosuquidar was determined from cryo-electron microscopy 3D single particle reconstruction of the complex at 3.9 Å resolution. The antigen is a hybrid construct of human and mouse ABCB1 (ABCB1HM) that contains the extracellular region of the human protein, including the recognition epitope of UIC2, on a background of mouse ABCB1 and was reconstituted into nanodiscs. A hydrolysis-defcient E ->Q variant of ABCB1HM was used.

The epitope of MRK16 on ABCB1 was determined from the single-particle cryo-EM reconstruction of the nanodisc reconstituted human ABCB1 in complex with MRK16 Fab and tariquidar, at a resolution of 3.6 Å. The use of MRK16-Fab increased the mass of the particles and helped break the pseudo twofold symmetry, allowing for high-resolution structure determination.

The crystal structure of scFv C219 in complex with the epitope, P-glycoprotein NBD, was determined by molecular replacement. There are two molecules in the crystallographic asymmetric unit. PDB chains for each complex are: Complex I : Antibody heavy-chain: B, Antibody light-chain: A, epitope chain: P. Complex II : Antibody heavy-chain: D, Antibody light-chain: C, epitope chain: Q. There was clear electron density for all 112 light chain and 120 heavy chain residues. In Complex II, continuous and unambiguous density was also seen for peptide residues. For the peptide in Complex I, electron density was readily interpretable only for residues 1–7. For residues 8-11, only backbone and Cβ atom density was observed and the side chains of these residues were excluded. Lastly, electron density was poor for peptide residues 12, 13 and 14 and these were not included in the model. Also, near the C terminus of the heavy chain, additional electron density was observed for residues belonging to the C-terminal c-myc epitope tag B: S121, G122, S123; in Complex I and, additionally, D: E124, Q125; in Complex II. The two scFv molecules in the asymmetric unit are virtually identical. In Complex II, the peptide forms a 3.5-turn helix. The equivalent 2.5-turn helical peptide in Complex I is virtually identical to the corresponding portion of the peptide in molecule II (residues 1-7). Complex II was used as the 3D complex because all peptide residues have electron density.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.4 angstroms

The epitope-specific nanobody Nb592 formed a complex with  mouse P-glycoprotein (P-gp; multidrug resistance protein 1A), as demonstrated by size exclusion chromatography and subsequently analyzed on SDS gels.

The epitope of nanobody Nb592 on the mouse P-glycoprotein (P-gp; multidrug resistance protein 1A) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. Nb592 binds to the C-terminus of the nucleotide-binding domain 1 (NBD1) and to NBD2. T626 is the last resolved residue at the C terminus of NBD1 and is proceeding a flexible linker region presumed disordered but could also potentially interact with Nb592.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 4.1 angstroms

The epitope of UIC2 Fab on the multidrug transporter ABCB1 (P-glycoprotein) bound to zosuquidar was determined from cryo-electron microscopy 3D single particle reconstruction of the complex at 3.56 Å resolution. The antigen is a hybrid construct of human and mouse ABCB1 (ABCB1HM) that contains the extracellular region of the human protein, including the recognition epitope of UIC2, on a background of mouse ABCB1. In addition, a variant was generated with two Ser to Cys mutations at positions 559 and 1,204 in the dimerization (D)-loops that allowed disulfide cross-linking of the nucleotide binding domains (NBDs) of the transporter (ABCB1HM-X).

The epitope of UIC2 Fab on the multidrug transporter (ABCB1 (P-glycoprotein), in the absence of drugs or nucleotides, was determined from cryo-electron microscopy 3D single particle reconstruction of the complex at 4.14 Å resolution. The antigen is a hybrid construct of human and mouse ABCB1 (ABCB1HM) that contains the extracellular region of the human protein, including the recognition epitope of UIC2, on a background of mouse ABCB1. In addition, a variant was generated with two Ser to Cys mutations at positions 559 and 1,204 in the dimerization (D)-loops that allowed disulfide cross-linking of the nucleotide binding domains (NBDs) of the transporter (ABCB1HM-X).
